concept.title: Opened files and copies
concept.shortdesc: On Windows, uFTi works on the file you open, so make a copy first if you want the original left alone.

conbody.p: Each workspace is one family tree file. When you open a family tree file, saves your changes to that file as you go.

section.title: Leave the original alone
section.p: The file you open changes as you work. If you want the original left alone, work on a copy. Make the copy before you change anything. Then open the copy, and keep the original safe.

section.title: Make a copy
section.p: Choose on the card for your tree. A sheet named asks which kind of file to make. Choose , unless you need a plain family tree file for another program. Then Windows asks where to put the file.
A copy made this way is a saved copy. It is a file of its own, and it stays as it was when you made it. To work on the copy, open it.

section.title: Sending your tree
section.p: Send a copy that you saved with , and not one of the other files. says why.
